normalize_image_sample: normalize an image sample by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
prepare_sample_for_network: transpose and convert image, depth, and valid mask to contiguous float32 arrays for network input
random_crop_sample: randomly crop an image sample along with its depth map and valid mask to a specified size
randomly_flip_sample_horizontal: randomly flip an image sample and its depth map and valid mask horizontally with 50 percent probability
build_transform_pipeline: build a monocular depth estimation data transform pipeline using NormalizeImage, PrepareForNet, Crop, and HorizontalFlip classes
